_comment: EarnControls' initial governed settings, in whole dollars (scaled by the reserve token's decimals at deploy). offeringCap is Earn §1's initial $1,000,000 BurnerBond offering cap. holderCapFloor is decision 23's bootstrap floor (the plan suggests about $1m): the 10% holder cap applies only while Pool Assets exceed it. fundingLimit, poolOfferingCap and poolCapacity are placeholders until the Holdings Board (Funding Limit) and the Lending Board (pool capacity, IV-03 maximum) set them; fundingResolution is then that resolution's hash.
